name: creative-automation-pipeline
description: Build tooling for the app's stylesheet. The app itself is Python; Node is only needed to recompile static/tailwind-*.css after editing styles/*.css.

scripts.css: tailwindcss -i styles/index.css -o static/tailwind-index.css --minify && tailwindcss -i styles/result.css -o static/tailwind-result.css --minify && node scripts/stamp_css.js
